brief:
Israeli authorities demolished 80 structures in Al-Dahiya village in the Negev Desert, displacing approximately 400 Palestinians, Al Jazeera English reported. The demolitions targeted residential and other buildings in the community.

The operation marks the latest in a series of demolitions affecting Palestinian communities in the Negev region, where Israel's Bedouin population faces longstanding disputes over land rights and settlement designations.
dek: Israeli authorities have demolished 80 structures in Al-Dahiya village in Israel’s Negev Desert…
title: Israel demolishes 80 structures in Negev village, displacing 400 Palestinians
